summary: Squire's own browser runs in a window of its own on the Mac that the owner can watch and take over in, by default gives a website none of the owner's details, and signs in to the owner's accounts only on their yes; an app the owner said yes to runs from a one-page brief through plan, build, test and a preview on this Mac, keeps its work when a step fails, keeps its versions on this Mac only, and needs its own yes to ship.
title: Squire's own browser, and apps built on the owner's yes
